title: Analyzing Endpoint DLP Scan for a User: Data at Rest

blocks.text: The Data at Rest page (Data Security > Endpoint DLP > Endpoint Data Scan > User Investigation > [click a user] > Data at Rest) displays Endpoint Data Loss Prevention (DLP) scan details for the user you select on the User Investigation page. The drawer shows the latest Endpoint Data Scan details from the user's perspective.
The following sections are available on the Data at Rest page:

blocks.item: Select All Endpoints or a specific endpoint for which you want to view the data for on this page. Applicable only when users have more than one endpoint.
Total Files Scanned: View the number of files scanned on the user endpoint.
Top Sensitive Data: The number of sensitive files discovered for the DLP engines and AI & ML categories on the endpoints. Click View All to view a detailed list of sensitive files.
Sensitive Data by File Type: The number of sensitive files discovered by file type (e.g., PDF, TXT, ZIP).
Files with Sensitive Data: View the number of sensitive files stored on the user endpoint. You can also view the increase or decrease in the percentage for the current week.

Top Sensitive Files Discovered: The table shows the top 20 sensitive files based on DLP engines and AL & ML category match. Export the data to analyze the complete list of sensitive files discovered. For each file, you can view:
File Name: The name of the file.
DLP Engines: The DLP engines triggered by the file.
AI & ML Categories: The AL & ML categories for the file.
Path: The path where the file is stored on the endpoint.
Dictionaries: The list of DLP dictionaries triggered by the file.
File Type: The file type (TXT, ZIP, DOCX).
SHA256: The unique and irreversible hash of the file used for cryptographic security.
Export the data to analyze the complete list of sensitive files discovered.
